subject: pe
title: Outdoor Activities: Kayaking
welcome_lead: Paddle on rivers and lakes — feel the water move you.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: kayaking basics, safety, strokes.
final_note: Wear a buoyancy aid — every paddle, every time.

concepts.def: Small boat paddled while seated low.
Stick with blades, used to move kayak.

walkthroughs.body_html: Always wear a buoyancy aid. Tell someone where you're going. Stay close to instructors at first.
The forward stroke sends you ahead. Sweep strokes turn you. Practice on calm water before moving water.
Flat lakes are easiest. Rivers are graded 1 (easy) to 6 (extreme). Stick to your level and wear a helmet on moving water.
